# iCan Thinking

> iCan Thinking is a positive thinking method, app and community created by coach, mentor and international keynote speaker Marcus Thomlinson. Its motto is "Small daily wins. Big life changes." People start free, then add courses, small cohorts or one-to-one coaching.

The brand is written "iCan Thinking" (a small "i", capital "C"). It is not related to ICANN.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://icanthinking.com/): overview of the method, levels, courses, app and community
- [Start free](https://icanthinking.com/start/): join iCan Start, the free level (community, habit tracking, three taster lessons)
- [Reviews](https://icanthinking.com/reviews/): testimonials from coaching clients and from people who have heard Marcus speak
- [About Marcus Thomlinson](https://icanthinking.com/about-marcus/): biography, speaking and keynote information

## Courses
- [iCan Thinking Foundation Course](https://icanthinking.com/courses/foundation/): 21 short practical modules on calm, goals, habits and confidence
- [iCan Grow](https://icanthinking.com/courses/grow/): business plan and user manual in one for owner-managed businesses
- [iCan Lead](https://icanthinking.com/courses/lead/): coming soon
- [iCan Speak](https://icanthinking.com/courses/speak/): coming soon
- [iCan Sell](https://icanthinking.com/courses/sell/): coming soon
- [iCan Be Wealthy](https://icanthinking.com/courses/be-wealthy/): coming soon

## Levels of involvement
iCan Start (free), iCan Commit (monthly or yearly), iCan Together (small cohorts of up to 12 people), iCan Personal (one-to-one coaching, by application), with honours of iCan Champion and iCan Master.
